verification_scope_reason: Native captured process layer is compared with actual Source runProfilePnpm over unchanged admitted profiles using the same controlled executable. Covers normal/empty/nonzero completion, separate stdout/stderr callbacks, raw CRLF logs, bounded byte tails including partial UTF-8, large output, silence deadline versus ongoing progress, caller cancellation, pre-aborted calls and missing commands, and run-record removal. Native additionally observes actual Windows parent/descendant handles for Task cancellation and for a normally exiting parent with inherited pipes; both are stopped before the record is removed. Foreign records cannot be overwritten. An output observer exception stops the run and preserves its log. The first test exposed record retention after an observer error even though process cleanup had succeeded; ownership completion is now recorded before propagating reader errors. Original Source operations-process tests explicitly skip its three POSIX descendant cases on Windows; these are not claimed as Source passes.
legal_adaptation: Source pre-aborted captured invocation returned exitCode 0 while emitting an abort diagnostic in the observed Windows run (recorded in source.stderr). Native refuses to start and returns 1, verified with a must-not-run marker. This one status is excluded from paired equality and is an intentional fail-closed adaptation, not parity. Empty/missing/abort OS diagnostic text compares as presence only. UTF-8 callback text is decoded per received chunk in both implementations; chunk boundaries differ, so the Unicode case compares callback presence while its full raw log and returned byte tail remain exact. Python owns a Windows Job: after a normal parent exit, a descendant that holds inherited pipes is stopped after the same two-second drain bound before return, rather than allowed to outlive the operation.
activation_boundary: Captured service process engine only, with caller-owned write lock and prior run admission. Profile mutation pre/postconditions, compatibility rollback/repair, bundle reconciliation, manager install/update/removal and the built-in Python package backend remain to be composed. CLI inherited descriptors are outside this engine. No full operation or release acceptance is claimed.

cleanup.retained: Compact commands, logs, XML/JSON, Source abort observation and resolved failure observations; shared Source/toolchains remain through C9.
